baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative نَجَّيْنَا is followed by ءَامَنُوا and the durative وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: An external rescuer effects separation from danger, while the recipients are identified by heart-settling trust that had become an ongoing practice of placing themselves in protection.

activation_trace.role: Separation that yields release supplies the external deliverance operation.
Heart-settling assent supplies the recipients' inward orientation.
Temporal presence makes protection a continuing prior state, not a last-minute act.
Reflexive self-placement in protection supplies the recipients' sustained practice.

changed_reading.before: A bare report that believers who feared God were saved.
changed_reading.after: A causative deliverance selects people whose settled trust had become an ongoing protective posture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of نَجَّيْنَا with يَتَّقُونَ links effected escape to protective practice.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human beings repeatedly interpose protection against injury, and divine deliverance completes that barrier logic by separating them from the harmful field altogether.

activation_trace.role: A barrier that wards off injury supplies the local protective operation.
Release by separation turns partial guarding into completed removal from danger.
Settled security names the human state toward which the barrier and separation converge.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is an ethical label attached to those rescued.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is the practiced barrier whose logic divine rescue brings to full separation and security.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ن ج و inventory attached to نَجَّيْنَا includes a raised refuge that inundation does not overtop.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliverance can be spatially imagined as transfer into a higher, wider position, with protective practice functioning as prior orientation toward survivable ground.

activation_trace.role: Raised ground beyond an inundating reach supplies a spatial model of rescue.
Protective interposition makes the raised location function as refuge rather than mere altitude.

changed_reading.before: Rescue is only removal from a threat.
changed_reading.after: Rescue may also be emplacement on survivable ground beyond the threat's reach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ن ج و inventory attached to نَجَّيْنَا includes scraping, peeling, cutting, and extracting a usable core.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliverance can be materially modeled as extracting a person from an adhered or enclosing layer rather than merely transporting the person away.

activation_trace.role: Peeling and extracting a core supplies the material operation of release.
Settled assent supplies what remains coherent through the imagined extraction.

changed_reading.before: The rescued group is moved intact from one location to another.
changed_reading.after: The rescued group is extracted from an enclosing condition while its trusted orientation remains intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence offers gentle direction, records attachment to blindness, and then lets the overhead shock seize people through what they acquired. The focus pair of trust and ongoing protection becomes the inverse pathway through that same decision-consequence chain.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent anchors the focus group's opposite response to offered direction.
Ongoing self-protection anchors the alternative trajectory after assent.
Gentle indication toward a true path supplies the offered directional option.
Heart-adhering preference turns blindness from passive lack into chosen attachment.
Blindness of inward perception names the selected counter-orientation.
An overhead crashing strike supplies the destructive field from which separation is effected.
Acquisition makes the terminal seizure answer a built-up human trajectory.

structural_cues: 41:17 orders guidance, preference, blindness, seizure, and acquisition immediately before 41:18.
The contrastive rescue in 41:18 closes the paired destruction accounts of 41:15-17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the offered path, chosen blindness, earned seizure, and then rescue; I infer that the focus group forms the inverse response chain. A live alternative is that rescue is selective without the text asserting a mechanically causal path from practice to rescue.

changed_reading.before: Belief and taqwa are static qualifications for rescue.
changed_reading.after: Belief and taqwa mark the counter-trajectory to preferred blindness: receiving direction, maintaining protection, and thus being separated when the destructive chain closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing, sight, and skin become informed witnesses, attempted covering fails, and a false supposition causes a fall. Faith and habitual protection therefore read as inward-bodily congruence that does not depend on keeping one's record covered.

activation_trace.role: Trusted inward assent anchors the integrity side of the model.
Continuing temporal presence makes protective conduct a recordable history.
Knowledgeable declaration turns embodied history into explicit evidence.
The body's outer covering becomes an evidence-bearing participant.
Covering supplies the failed strategy against exposure.
Unfounded supposition supplies the inward distortion behind attempted concealment.
Falling into ruin supplies the endpoint opposed to focus deliverance.

structural_cues: 41:20-22 repeats the same bodily faculties first as witnesses and then as objects one cannot hide from.
The post-focus sequence links what people continually did to what their bodies later disclose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embodied testimony, failed covering, false supposition, and ruin; I infer that habitual taqwa produces a life that can survive disclosure. The live alternative is that these verses only expose the condemned and do not positively define the rescued group.

changed_reading.before: Faith is inward and taqwa is an externally observed qualification.
changed_reading.after: Faith and taqwa form an integrated inward-bodily history whose openness to truthful witness is itself protective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attached companions beautify the field before and behind a person, then a coordinated noise strategy blocks hearing so that domination can follow. Taqwa becomes protection of the social and auditory conditions under which trust is formed and maintained.

activation_trace.role: Trusted assent anchors the receptive state that the surrounding noise seeks to prevent.
Interposed protection extends from overt harm to corrupting social and auditory inputs.
An attached companion supplies the persistent social channel of influence.
Making something appear attractive supplies the distortion applied to the person's temporal field.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the receptive function being targeted.
Mixed clamor supplies the masking mechanism used against meaningful hearing.
Coercive overcoming states the intended result of the masking strategy.

structural_cues: 41:25 spans what is before and behind the influenced person, then 41:26 moves from surroundings to deliberate listening sabotage.
The coordinated imperatives in 41:26 expose noise as a social tactic rather than accidental distraction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, beautification, blocked hearing, clamor, and intended domination; I infer that focus taqwa includes guarding the channels that stabilize faith. A live alternative is that taqwa here remains general moral vigilance rather than a specific attentional practice.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa protects a person mainly from direct acts of wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa also guards the social and auditory ecology in which false attractiveness and strategic noise can capture trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: A declared allegiance is followed by sustained straightness; descending messengers then remove anticipated harm and inward grief, confirm the promised destination, and announce protective companionship across both lives. The focus rescue becomes a temporally extended transition into defended nearness.

activation_trace.role: Continuing presence anchors the duration later sharpened by sustained straightness.
Persistent self-placement in protection anchors the focus group's maintained orientation.
Straight, balanced continuance gives behavioral shape to the focus durative.
Descending and becoming present initiates the answering movement from above.
Expected harm names the forward-looking threat that reassurance removes.
Inward roughness from grief names the burden that reassurance smooths.
A promise opening hope supplies the secured future destination.
Near protective alliance extends rescue as companionship across present and future life.

structural_cues: 41:30 orders confession, straight continuance, descent, reassurance, and promise.
41:31 explicitly spans worldly and later life, giving the protective relation temporal continuity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies straight continuance followed by descent, reassurance, promise, and alliance; I read that sequence as an expanded realization of the focus rescue. A live alternative is that 41:30-31 describes a parallel reward scene rather than unpacking 41:18.

changed_reading.before: Rescue is a punctual extraction after danger arrives.
changed_reading.after: Rescue unfolds from sustained straightness into descending reassurance, freedom from anticipated and remembered harm, and protective companionship across both lives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection has two active modes: answer interpersonal evil with a better act so hostility can become alliance, and meet divisive incitement by entering divine refuge. Patient self-restraint keeps either response from reproducing the incoming harm.

activation_trace.role: Warding by interposition anchors protection as an operation rather than a label.
Enacted good supplies the counter-material used against incoming harm.
Pushing an injury aside supplies the active protective motion.
Hostility supplies the relation subjected to transformation.
Protective affection and alliance supply the transformed relational state.
Holding the self back from reactive distress regulates the counter-response.
Incitement that corrupts relations supplies the internal trigger requiring protection.
Entering a protecting refuge supplies the response to divisive incitement.

structural_cues: 41:34 gives a before-and-after relation: hostility becomes close alliance through a better counter-action.
41:35-36 place patient restraint and refuge-seeking directly after the transformation command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repulsion by a better act, transformed relation, restraint, incitement, and refuge; I infer that these are operational forms of focus taqwa. The live alternative is that the promised relational turn is an exemplary possibility, not a guaranteed causal result.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is defensive avoidance of harmful contact.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa can actively intercept harm without mirroring it, transform the relation that carried it, and relocate incitement into divine refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that marks the focus recipients' believing later marks a person arriving secure, in direct opposition to being cast into fire. The context folds the trust and security branches together across time.

activation_trace.role: Trusted assent names the focus group's initial orientation.
Being cast down supplies the forced destination opposed to deliverance.
Arrival in settled security supplies the realized state latent beside the focus act of trust.

structural_cues: The أَفَمَنْ ... أَمْ مَنْ opposition in 41:40 directly contrasts being cast into fire with coming secure.
The focus and 41:40 use different branches of the same resolved root across belief and security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a root-level trust/security relation and an explicit destination contrast; I infer that secure arrival retrospectively colors the focus act of believing. A live alternative is that ءَامِنًا describes only the outcome and does not explain the earlier act ءَامَنُوا.

changed_reading.before: Those who believed are rescued, with belief functioning as a separate criterion.
changed_reading.after: Their believing is the trust-side of a trajectory whose disclosed endpoint is coming secure rather than being cast down.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late-surah human type oscillates with contact: harm abruptly cuts off hope, favor produces entitlement, and ease produces bodily withdrawal. The focus durative marks a different temporality, a protective orientation maintained across changing contact conditions.

activation_trace.role: Continuing presence anchors protection as a history rather than an emergency reaction.
Repeated self-placement in protection supplies the stable posture.
The absence of any sideward escape exposes reactive evasion as unavailable.
Impacting contact makes the adverse condition an immediate state-change trigger.
Severed hope supplies the first extreme produced by adverse contact.
A second image of severed hope intensifies the unstable collapse.
Favorable condition supplies the opposite trigger in the oscillation.
Drawing one's side away gives bodily form to withdrawal under favor.
The bodily side localizes the turning-away posture.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeatedly alternates favorable and adverse conditions with sharply different human responses.
The focus وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ grammatically foregrounds prior continuity against these contact-driven reversals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating conditions and unstable responses; I infer that the focus durative identifies resilience across those conditions. A live alternative is that كَانُوا simply locates past conduct and carries no special contrastive force.

changed_reading.before: Those rescued happened to practice taqwa before the catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: Those rescued are distinguished by a protective orientation durable across harm and favor, unlike contact-driven despair, entitlement, and withdrawal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a topographic branch rather than the primary release sense of نَجَّيْنَا. It remains anchored in the focus root's raised-ground branch and is sharpened by water, earth-motion, and rising in 41:39. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial material analogy, not as the lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B004 branch of focus ن ج و permits rescue to be imagined as emplacement on raised ground beyond inundation.

activation_trace.role: A raised place not overtopped by inundation supplies the focus-side refuge image.
Water supplies the material field against which elevation becomes protective.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life turns refuge from static escape into renewed viability.
Raised earth directly reinforces the topographic branch activated at the focus.

changed_reading.before: The rescued are simply removed from the destructive field.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are set into raised, revivable terrain where the same material field no longer overwhelms them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the focus root's peeling-extraction branch to later speaking skins and failed covering. It remains anchored in ن ج و B003 and in the explicit skin, witness, and covering sequence of 41:20-22. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for release from concealment, never a claim that نَجَّيْنَا means flaying in this ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B003 branch of focus ن ج و models deliverance as extracting a core from an adhered outer layer.

activation_trace.role: Peeling and extracting supplies the focus-side material operation.
The bodily outer covering supplies the material layer that later becomes evidentiary.
Informed declaration makes exposure disclose rather than merely injure.
Covering supplies the enclosing strategy from which the extraction analogy releases the person.

changed_reading.before: Rescue preserves the person by keeping every covering intact.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rescue can preserve the trusted core by extracting it from a concealment regime that later turns its own coverings into witnesses.

strongest_changes: The pre-focus contrast turns belief and taqwa from static labels into the inverse pathway to preferred blindness and earned seizure.
The sustained-straightness sequence expands punctual rescue into reassurance, promised destination, and protective companionship across both lives.
The explicit 41:40 opposition joins the trust and security branches of ء م ن, so believing becomes the path toward arriving secure rather than being cast down.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converted the focus's compact rescue formula into mechanisms of trajectory, attention, embodied disclosure, temporal resilience, and active protection, while two distant ن ج و branches remained live as contained material analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly contrasts trajectories but does not state a deterministic causal law from taqwa to rescue.
The attentional and embodied-integrity readings are coherent extensions, though neither is explicitly named in 41:18.
The raised-ground and peeling-extraction readings should remain exploratory and must not displace the primary separation sense.
